_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 41 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 98,750 berths as of December 31, 2013'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2013 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 41 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 98,750 berths as of December 31, 2013'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2013 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 5.12x; +39% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.16; conservative 2yr +5%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.3%/yr (Q2 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.3%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2014-04-25) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 5.12x (96.1% downside to Bear $2 / +18.8% upside to Bull $61) | Adj composite 2.25 vs market 2.41: gap -0.16 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $37 (11x FY14E $3.35) | Conservative 2-yr case: +5.2% total (+2.6%/yr) | At 15.3x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $68 sits above the BULL case; Net Yields -2.7% in Q1 2014, forward net revenue +6.07-7.11% (Q2 2014 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
